title: 联合国秘书长候选人亮相 全球挑战与机遇并存
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Welcome, we are live, City, I'm Haslund Armin.
segments.zh: 欢迎收看，直播正在进行，我是哈斯伦德·阿明。

segments.en: And I'm Romain Bostic, live on Bloomberg. This is the UN Town Hall, the next Secretary-General presented by the President of the General
segments.zh: 我是罗曼·博斯蒂克，在彭博社直播。这里是联合国市政厅，下一任秘书长由联合国大会主席呈现。

segments.en: Assembly of the United Nations. To start, here's the President of the UN General Assembly and the Lena Bearbock.
segments.zh: 首先，有请联合国大会主席和莱娜·贝尔伯克。

segments.en: Ladies and gentlemen, dear world citizens, I greet you from the United Nations General Assembly Hall in New York.
segments.zh: 女士们，先生们，亲爱的世界公民们，我在纽约联合国大会厅向你们致意。

segments.en: The heart of multilaterism. Today marks a critical step in the selection of the next Secretary-General of the United
segments.zh: 多边主义的核心。今天标志着联合国下一任秘书长遴选的关键一步。

segments.en: Nations, probably one of the most challenging but also most honorable job in the world.
segments.zh: 这可能是世界上最具挑战性但也最光荣的工作之一。

segments.en: The person we choose will not only be the face of this House of Humanity, but also its custodian.
segments.zh: 我们选择的人不仅将成为这座人类之家的面孔，也将是其守护者。

segments.en: She or he will stand up for the United Nations Charter and all its three pillars, peace and security, sustainable development and human rights in the time of unprecedented challenges
segments.zh: 她或他将捍卫《联合国宪章》及其三大支柱：和平与安全、可持续发展、人权，在面临前所未有的挑战之际。

segments.en: Thanks to our media partner, Bloomberg, we have the chance to hear from all candidates today at one stage how they define strong principle leadership in our interconnected world,
segments.zh: 感谢我们的媒体合作伙伴彭博社，我们今天有机会在同一舞台上听取所有候选人阐述他们如何在互联世界中定义强有力的原则性领导力。

segments.en: how they will reform the UN to deliver more effectively and how they will truly represent
segments.zh: 他们将如何改革联合国，以更有效地运作，以及如何真正代表
